sinopsis.es: En alguna carretera de Ucrania, Ana, cooperante de una ONG española, ayuda a Yrina a huir de los bombardeos junto a su hijo Yure. Con el niño febril e Yrina agotada, Ana convence a la joven madre de subir al coche de una desconocida para salir cuanto antes. Pero dentro, Yrina no tarda en sospechar de la mujer, que actúa de manera secreta.
sinopsis.en: On a road somewhere in Ukraine, Ana, an aid worker for a Spanish NGO, helps Yrina flee the bombings with her son Yure. They want to reach the border as soon as possible and get to safety. With Yure running a fever and Yrina completely exhausted, Ana convinces the young mother to get into a stranger’s car and leave as soon as possible. But once inside the car, it doesn’t take long for Yrina to become suspicious of the woman. She sees signs in every detail, as the woman acts in a secretive manner.
